QuestInfo.name: [Battle Mode] Elite Guardian Training
QuestInfo.0: A letter came in for you. Check it out!
QuestInfo.1: You will be tested to see you if you are qualified to become an Elite Guardian. The time and date of your exam will be sent shortly.
QuestInfo.2: You will be tested to see you if you are qualified to become an Elite Guardian. The time and date of your exam will be sent shortly.

0.0:
Brave #h0#,
I am the great and mighty Haktorius, legionnaire supreme of the Maple Alliance. 
I am told you are a warrior of great potential, and that is exactly what I'm looking for!
The battle with the Black Mage is drawing near. His commanders are all over. We need able-bodied lunatics like yourself to stand up and fight!
I hope this letter finds you well. I also hope that you are as tough as you are made out to be, because I hate writing letters.
Will you help us?

yes.0: Take on the role of an Elite Guardian and protect Maple World from the Black Mage!\nYou will need grace in combat and a will of steel to take on the title, but a simple exam will qualify you for duty. I will send the time and date of your exam at a later... time and date.\n
